parameters.query:
select
  ci.content_id,
  ci.title,
  ci.category,
  ci.status,
  s.selected_hook,
  s.approved_by_human,
  p.publish_status,
  p.caption_final,
  p.hashtags_final,
  a.asset_id,
  a.provider,
  a.source_url,
  a.storage_url,
  a.mime_type,
  a.status as asset_status,
  a.metadata_json
from content_items ci
join scripts s on s.content_id = ci.content_id
join publishes p on p.content_id = ci.content_id
join lateral (
  select
    asset_id,
    provider,
    source_url,
    storage_url,
    mime_type,
    status,
    metadata_json,
    created_at
  from assets
  where content_id = ci.content_id
    and asset_role = 'post_image'
  order by created_at desc
  limit 1
) a on true
where ci.status = 'approval_pending'
  and p.platform = 'instagram'
  and p.publish_status in ('draft', 'failed')
  and a.status = 'ready'
order by ci.updated_at asc
limit 1;

update content_items
set status = '{{$json.next_content_status_sql}}',
    approved_at = case when '{{$json.approval_decision_sql}}' = 'approve' then now() else null end,
    updated_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid;

update scripts
set approved_by_human = case when '{{$json.approval_decision_sql}}' = 'approve' then true else false end
where content_id = '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid;

update assets
set status = '{{$json.next_asset_status_sql}}'
where asset_id = '{{$json.asset_id_sql}}'::uuid;

select ci.content_id, ci.status, ci.approved_at, s.approved_by_human, a.status as asset_status
from content_items ci
join scripts s on s.content_id = ci.content_id
join assets a on a.asset_id = '{{$json.asset_id_sql}}'::uuid
where ci.content_id = '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid;

insert into workflow_runs (
  content_id,
  workflow_name,
  run_status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Approval SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid,
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Approval SQL Values"].json["workflow_name_sql"]}}',
  'success',
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Review Package"].json["run_started_at"]}}'::timestamptz,
  now(),
  {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Approval SQL Values"].json["duration_ms_sql"]}},
  null,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'approval_decision', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Approval SQL Values"].json["approval_decision_sql"]}}',
    'review_note', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Approval SQL Values"].json["review_note_sql"]}}',
    'review_summary', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Approval SQL Values"].json["review_summary_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb
  )
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, ended_at;
